scope: One Q initial hit plus every successful native burst listener invocation bound to that exact status instance and all actual callback-chain attacks, including in-flight children after status termination. Q buff/shield effect quantities and separately dispatched reaction/weapon/artifact damage excluded.
preservation: Original AddStatus and firstbounce QueueAttackEvent each execute once. Existing event/callback sites and branch facts retained. Additional ownership annotations consume metadata already bound by generator trigger; no new status getter, RNG call, damage formula, gate, scheduler, or callback-order changes.
nonDamageCallbacksAndInitAudit: beidou.go Init registers only the audited burstProc and C4 HP-drain status listener. C4 damage attaches to later normal attack callbacks, not Q intrinsic attacks. Burst C1 creates shield only; C6 schedules resistance modifiers every30f through900f, no attack queue. Burst action return has no animation Queue or OnRemoved callback. Existing source A1 and C4 charged-attack TODOs remain source limitations, not completed game mechanics.
